title: Derived co-Yoneda and Fubini for space-valued enriched modules
statement:
Use small simplicial categories and weak homotopy equivalences from [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison], enriched modules and their coends from [def-coef-enriched-coend], and projective cofibrant replacements from [lem-coef-simplicial-projective-model-calculus]. All object sets and simplicial sets lie in a fixed universe. For a covariant module $X:A\to\mathsf{sSet}$ and a contravariant module $Y:A^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathsf{sSet}$, write $X\otimes_A^{\mathbb L}Y$ for the homotopy type of the enriched coend of projective cofibrant replacements of both modules, with factors written in chronological order: the underlying coend has summands $X(a)\times Y(a)$. It can also be computed by the two-sided enriched bar with degree $n$ equal to
$$\coprod_{a_0,\ldots,a_n}X(a_0)\times A(a_0,a_1)\times\cdots\times A(a_{n-1},a_n)\times Y(a_n),$$
using composition and actions for faces, identities for degeneracies, and homotopy realization. This derived coend is invariant under objectwise weak homotopy equivalences of either module. For every object $a$ of $A$, the action augmentation is a natural weak equivalence
$$A(a,-)\otimes_A^{\mathbb L}Y\simeq Y(a).$$
For small simplicial categories $A,B$, a covariant $A$-module $X$, a bimodule $M:A^{\mathrm{op}}\times B\to\mathsf{sSet}$, and a contravariant $B$-module $Y$, the canonical Fubini comparison is a natural equivalence
$$(X\otimes_A^{\mathbb L}M)\otimes_B^{\mathbb L}Y\simeq X\otimes_A^{\mathbb L}(M\otimes_B^{\mathbb L}Y).$$
The comparisons retain any additional enriched module variables and commute with augmentations induced by composition pairings. No local Kan condition on $A$ or $B$ is required.
